rule: Locale file parsing security (prevent injection via malformed translation keys)
bounty_amount: Tiered corporate sponsorship (Platinum/Gold/Silver tiers with Zen Architects, Plaid, NuxtLabs, Localazy, Crowdin, VueMastery, Froggly)
roi_summary: Vue I18n is a mature, widely-adopted internationalization library (70% PR merge rate, 558+ merges) with explicit tiered corporate sponsorship from named companies. While not a traditional grant program, the corporate sponsorship represents significant, verifiable financial commitment to project maintenance.
reasoning: The vue-i18n project displays named corporate sponsors at multiple tiers (Platinum: Zen Architects, Plaid; Gold: NuxtLabs, Localazy, Crowdin). issue_info.body: StackStorm (IFTTT for Ops) is an event-driven automation platform for DevOps/SRE teams featuring a rules engine, workflow orchestration, 160+ integration packs with 6000+ actions, ChatOps support, and extensibility through custom sensors and actions.

rule: validate-workflow-security - StackStorm workflows execute arbitrary actions/scripts and require strict input sanitization and permission scoping validation.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Lightweight container orchestration tool providing Docker Compose deployment across distributed Docker hosts using WireGuard mesh networking with decentralized peer-to-peer state synchronization.

rule: NE200 - Network configuration should validate CIDR ranges and avoid overlapping subnets in mesh configurations
roi_summary: Active container orchestration tool with FUNDING.yml, GitHub sponsors, and 80% PR merge rate. Well-documented with Discord community. Good ROI for DevOps/infrastructure contributors seeking Docker Compose-style deployment tools.
reasoning: Has FUNDING.yml with GitHub Sponsors enabled, active Discord community (600+ members), professional documentation at uncloud.run, and 80% PR merge rate. Shows genuine maintainer commitment with wireguard mesh networking and decentralized architecture.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: This repository contains the work-in-progress Markdown sources for JSON Schema IETF Internet Draft documents, including validation, annotation, and manipulation specifications.

rule: spec-contributor-acknowledgment
roi_summary: Specification work is high-value but contributor payouts are not documented; donors fund operations, not bounties.
reasoning: OpenCollective funding exists with active financial contributors, but there is no named grant program, beneficiary list, or evidence of structured contributor payouts. The JSON Schema org is a standards body with good process, but the funding mechanism is donations, not bounties.

rule: flask-security-best-practices

issue_info.body: Coconut is a functional programming language that extends Python with elegant syntax for pattern matching, partial application, lazy evaluation, and other FP paradigms, transpiling to standard Python.

rule: Python bytecode compilation integrity - Coconut transpiles to Python, ensure generated code preserves original semantics

rule: SQL injection prevention in raw query execution and secure password hashing implementation
roi_summary: Multiple funding platforms active (GitHub, LiberaPay, custom) with 87% PR merge rate. Note: PR submissions are temporarily paused due to maintainer bandwidth.
reasoning: Wakapi has active funding infrastructure across GitHub Sponsors and LiberaPay platforms, with 87% PR merge rate indicating healthy community contribution. However, friendliness is tempered by explicit notice that PRs are temporarily not accepted due to maintainer time constraints.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Fider is a Go/TypeScript feedback collection platform that enables organizations to gather and prioritize user feedback, available as both cloud-hosted SaaS and self-hosted solution.

rule: CSRF-PROTECTION: Validate state tokens for OAuth and authentication flows
roi_summary: Established feedback platform with active OpenCollective, transparent sponsorship tiers, and strong community governance. High PR merge rate (82%) with 757 merged PRs demonstrates sustainable project health.
reasoning: Fider has verified OpenCollective funding with explicit donation paths, sponsorship tiers, and active contributor base. The project shows clear governance with CONTRIBUTING.md and transparent community management. 757 merged PRs and 82% merge rate confirms active maintenance and contributor compensation through sustainable operations.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: N-D labeled arrays and datasets library for Python, providing pandas-like labeling on NumPy arrays with tight dask integration for parallel computing.

rule: Array dimension and coordinate validation for multi-dimensional data
roi_summary: Scientific Python library with institutional backing via NumFOCUS and Tidelift. 91% PR merge rate is exceptional. No explicit grant program with named beneficiaries, but institutional funding provides more structure than personal sponsorships. FRIENDLY SEED candidate.
reasoning: Institutional funding via NumFOCUS (established scientific Python fiscal sponsor) and Tidelift provides more legitimacy than personal sponsorships. No explicit named grant recipients or payout receipts visible, but institutional backing is stronger than average.

rule: ssl-certificate-validation

reasoning: Multi-platform funding (GitHub, Tidelift, Open Collective) indicates strong financial support for maintainers, but no explicit grant program for contributors, named beneficiaries, or payout history documentation found. rule: API rate limiting for Earth Engine

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Single-binary OpenAI-compatible inference server supporting GGUF and SafeTensors models with automatic model discovery and multi-GPU backend support.

rule: Model file validation and sandboxing
bounty_amount: GitHub Sponsors + Ko-fi + Open Collective + Buy Me a Coffee
roi_summary: Rust inference server with explicit tiered sponsorship ($5-$500/month). Multiple funding platforms with clear benefits. 82% PR merge rate and welcoming tone throughout.
reasoning: FUNDING.yml present with GitHub Sponsors, Ko-fi, Open Collective, and Buy Me a Coffee. Explicit sponsorship tiers documented in README with concrete benefits.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Zen is an open-source system-wide ad-blocker and privacy guard for Windows, macOS, and Linux that operates at the proxy level to block ads, trackers, malware, and unwanted content across all applications.

rule: For a privacy tool handling HTTPS interception, certificate validation and secure proxy configuration rules are essential quality targets.
roi_summary: Active Open Collective funding infrastructure with strong community engagement. High PR merge rate (90%) and Discord presence indicate active project health. Privacy tool with legitimate purpose.
reasoning: The project has FUNDING.yml present and is funded through Open Collective. The 90% merge rate (299 merged / 33 closed) demonstrates active maintenance and welcoming contribution patterns. Discord community and comprehensive documentation signal a healthy ecosystem.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Middy is a stylish Node.js middleware engine for AWS Lambda that provides reusable middleware components for common cross-cutting concerns like validation, error handling, and authentication in serverless applications.

rule: For a Node.js middleware engine, input sanitization middleware and error handling validation rules are primary quality targets given middleware chains process untrusted Lambda input.
roi_summary: Explicit named sponsors (fourTheorem, AWS FOSS Fund) with dual GitHub funding sources. Exceptional community engagement with 617 merged PRs at 66% merge rate. 100% code coverage and comprehensive governance documentation.
reasoning: Verified named sponsors and AWS FOSS Fund contributions. The project demonstrates professional open-source governance with CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SLSA Level 3 compliance, and 100% test coverage. Active maintenance with high-volume contributor engagement confirms legitimate funding ecosystem.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: JavaScript-based OpenStreetMap editor built with D3.js, providing an accessible browser-based tool for mapping geographic data with intentional simplicity and broad platform support.

rule: GeoJSON/JSON schema validation for map data integrity and OSM API rate limiting compliance
roi_summary: Has a historical Knight Foundation grant mentioned in README but no active funding infrastructure, grant program, or contributor payout mechanism. 70% PR merge rate with high volume (2698 merged) shows massive community contribution but no financial compensation structure.
reasoning: The README explicitly acknowledges 'Initial development of iD was made possible by a grant of the Knight Foundation' but this is historical, not active. Funding Platforms shows 'Not Funded' and no FUNDING.YML exists. While the project has excellent contributor friendliness (Code of Conduct, welcoming docs, multiple contribution paths), there is zero evidence of active grants, foundation funding, or contributor payout infrastructure. High PR volume proves contribution is welcome but unpaid.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon

rule: Schema validation completeness (required fields, type correctness)
roi_summary: Massive contributor-friendly repository (92% merge rate) hosting JSON schemas, but no evidence of contributor grants or payouts. Infrastructure sponsorship requested from for-profit users, not a contributor bounty program.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: A SQLite runtime loadable extension enabling multi-master replication and conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs) for offline-first, collaborative database editing across devices.

rule: RS008 (unused variables) or CWE-89 (SQL injection) given SQLite extension and CRDT merge logic.
bounty_amount: Corporate Sponsor Backing (Turso, Fly.io, Reflect.app, Expo, Electric SQL) + Individual Sponsors
roi_summary: Complex Rust/C codebase with CRDT/SQLite expertise required, but backed by major industry players (Turso is a serious database company) providing strong ecosystem value and potential employment opportunities.
reasoning: Corporate sponsors Turso, Fly.io, Reflect.app, Expo, and Electric SQL provide funding legitimacy. Individual sponsors listed in README. 91% PR merge rate demonstrates active maintenance and welcoming contributions. vlcn.io ecosystem is well-established with live production examples.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: A single-binary web UI for qBittorrent enabling multi-instance management, automated torrent workflows, cross-seeding, and rule-based automation from a lightweight frontend application.

rule: SEC101 ( secrets detection) or S6802 (hardcoded credentials) due to torrent client API key management.
bounty_amount: Multi-Platform Donations (GitHub Sponsors x2, Patreon, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, Crypto)
roi_summary: Well-funded via multiple donation platforms with crypto verification system. Premium theme sales provide additional revenue. Clear contribution path despite collaborator-only PR restriction.
reasoning: Multiple funding platforms active: GitHub Sponsors (2 maintainers), Patreon, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, and cryptocurrency with on-chain verification at crypto.getqui.com. 89% PR merge rate shows active maintenance. Donations explicitly support ongoing development.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: A VS Code file nesting configuration snippet that organizes file trees by nesting related files (configs, tests, types) under parent files, with automated updates via a companion VS Code extension.

rule: Ensure CSS-in-JS styles are scoped and minified for bundle-size efficiency given goober's <1KB mission
roi_summary: Open Collective provides transparent funding; "The Great Shave Off Challenge" pays contributors for byte-reduction PRs; 50% PR merge rate with active maintenance; excellent ROI for focused CSS-in-JS contributions
reasoning: goober has active Open Collective backing with named sponsors and backers, plus explicit bounty program ("The Great Shave Off") that pays for byte-shaving PRs. The 50% merge rate confirms active maintenance. Combined with comprehensive docs and clear API, this is a legitimate funded ecosystem.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Maestral is an open-source Dropbox client for macOS and Linux that syncs local folders with Dropbox using the public API, supporting multiple accounts and exclusion patterns.

rule: File sync operations should handle concurrent conflicts gracefully and preserve Dropbox API rate limits to prevent account suspension
roi_summary: Maestral has GitHub Sponsors set up with active funding. 86% PR merge rate and 432 merged PRs demonstrate highly welcoming, active community. Excellent documentation and multiple packaging options (Homebrew, PyPI, Docker) indicate professional ecosystem. Good ROI for Dropbox sync feature contributions.
reasoning: GitHub Sponsors present with active funding. The 86% merge rate (432/503) and extensive documentation (ReadTheDocs, CONTRIBUTING.md) show an exceptionally welcoming community. Top-tier friendliness with clear CLI docs, Docker support, and multiple platform packaging.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Converse.js is a full-featured XMPP/Jabber web client supporting multiple display modes (overlay, fullpage, embedded), OMEMO end-to-end encryption, and 45+ XMPP extensions.

rule: XMPP message handling should sanitize user content to prevent XSS vulnerabilities in chat overlay/embedded modes
roi_summary: Converse.js has active Patreon and Liberapay funding with 37% PR merge rate but high absolute volume (728 merged PRs). Well-documented with 40+ language translations and comprehensive XMPP protocol support. Good ROI for JavaScript contributors to a mature chat application. Funding infrastructure is explicit.
reasoning: Patreon and Liberapay confirmed with active funding. 728 merged PRs demonstrates substantial contributor ecosystem. Comprehensive docs (quickstart, configuration, plugin development) and active XMPP protocol implementation. Transparent governance with clear contributor guidelines.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: A Rust game engine framework for building Minecraft: Java Edition servers from scratch using Bevy ECS, supporting authentication, encryption, chunks, entities, and full protocol abstraction.

rule: Protocol Compliance: Minecraft protocol implementations require strict adherence to Mojang specification to prevent desync and exploits.

issue_info.body: novelWriter is a Qt6/PyQt6-based plain text editor for novel writing, using a minimal Markdown-inspired syntax with meta-data support for cross-referencing and synopsis, stored as human-readable plain text files.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Kodiak is a GitHub bot that automatically updates and merges pull requests, supporting dependency bots like Dependabot for automated PR management.

rule: Webhook signature validation for GitHub App integrations
roi_summary: GitHub Sponsors integration with explicit sponsorship request for commercial users; high-value tool with clear monetization path.
reasoning: FUNDING_YML present with GitHub Sponsors link. README explicitly asks commercial users to support via sponsors to cover server costs. High merge rate (91%) confirms active maintenance. GitHub Marketplace listing validates commercial viability.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Colab-ssh enables SSH connections to Google Colab notebooks via cloudflared tunnels, with optional Git/GitLab integration and VSCode support.

rule: SSH tunnel security hardening and credential handling
roi_summary: Colab-ssh has explicit funding infrastructure (GitHub Sponsors + IssueHunt) with an 88% PR merge rate, indicating active maintenance and willingness to reward contributors.
reasoning: The project has FUNDING.yml present with GitHub and IssueHunt platforms, demonstrating explicit funding mechanics for contributors.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: ItyFuzz is a bytecode-level hybrid fuzzer combining symbolic execution and fuzzing to find vulnerabilities in EVM and MoveVM smart contracts, backed by LibAFL.

rule: Smart contract reentrancy and integer overflow detection
roi_summary: ItyFuzz has explicit grant backing from Manifold Finance and Sui, active bug bounty payouts documented in their bug table ($79k, $35k, $19k+ incidents), and an active 89% PR merge rate with Discord/Telegram community.
reasoning: README explicitly lists sponsors (Manifold Finance, Sui) and documents specific vulnerabilities found with dollar amounts at risk, providing concrete evidence of past payout activity.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Rauthy is a lightweight SSO identity provider supporting OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, and PAM, with heavy emphasis on passkeys and security. Written in Rust for memory efficiency and can run on minimal hardware like Raspberry Pi.

rule: FIDO2/WebAuthn implementation correctness and token signing algorithm validation

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: A minimalist BASIC-to-Python compiler written in Python, designed as a teaching tool for compiler construction with three-part tutorial series.

rule: Memory safety in generated C code output to prevent buffer overflows in compiled programs
roi_summary: Minimal effort compiler project with clear tutorial structure. Corporate sponsorship from recall.ai provides verified funding signal, though project scope is small and educational rather than production-critical.
reasoning: FUNDING.yml is PRESENT with GITHUB funding enabled. README explicitly displays recall.ai as corporate sponsor with job posting. The project is educational with tutorial blog posts (parts 1-3), showing transparent sponsorship acknowledgment.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: High-performance particle physics simulation addon for Blender 4.2+/5.1+ featuring Cython-optimized molecular dynamics, multi-threaded processing, and spatial hash grid acceleration for real-time particle simulations.

rule: Thread safety in Cython simulation core to prevent race conditions during parallel particle computations
roi_summary: Medium-effort Blender addon with high performance focus. Active GitHub Sponsors page and PayPal donations provide verified funding mechanisms. 59% PR merge rate indicates healthy maintenance with good community engagement.
reasoning: FUNDING.yml is PRESENT and GITHUB funded. README includes PayPal donation button and GitHub Sponsors link. Discord community active. The project shows active development (spatial hash rewrite in v1.21.9) with transparent funding infrastructure.

issue_info.title: Deep Recon
issue_info.body: Long-standing Redis object mapper for Python providing Django/SQLAlchemy-style ORM semantics with support for various data types, indexing strategies, and Redis-specific features like Lua scripting and geo-indexing.

rule: Redis connection string injection prevention to block unauthorized Redis command execution
roi_summary: Mature Redis ORM library with 10+ years of history. GitHub funding enabled with explicit licensing-for-sponsorship model. Historical sponsors (structd.com, chownow.com) demonstrate past commercial usage. 44% merge rate shows moderate but consistent maintenance.
reasoning: FUNDING.yml is PRESENT with GITHUB funding enabled. README explicitly states 'Sponsorships Available' with license exceptions for sponsors. Historical commercial usage documented. The licensing model explicitly ties sponsorship to commercial license flexibility.
